gates.name: Sample sufficiency
gates.threshold: n >= 300 and seasons >= 3

gates.name: Break-even hurdle
gates.threshold: hit rate > 0.52381 at the price paid
gates.note: modal price 0.52381 break-even; observed 0.57222

gates.name: Hurdle exceeded beyond noise
gates.threshold: one-sided p < 0.05 vs break-even
gates.note: the profit is not explainable as a lucky run at this sample size

gates.name: Closing-line value
gates.threshold: median CLV > 0 with bootstrap LCB > 0

gates.name: Edge threshold / selectivity
gates.threshold: mean modelled EV >= hurdle + 0.02
gates.note: 0.0% of bets taken below the configured threshold; abstain rate 0.0

gates.name: Multiple-comparison control
gates.threshold: single candidate: correction not binding
gates.note: declare `trials` honestly: understating it is the one input that makes every other gate look better

gates.name: Overfitting deflator
gates.threshold: requires per-period returns and the trial dispersion
gates.note: no default dispersion is supplied on purpose: DSR with an invented trial count is decoration

gates.name: Hold realism
gates.threshold: recompute at measured hold by family
gates.note: regulator files not parsed (GAP-08); assumption remains the theoretical -110 margin, which flatters parlays

gates.threshold: max season share <= 45% and max team share <= 25%
gates.note: largest season 25.2% of gains, largest team 3.9%

gates.name: Walk-forward only
gates.threshold: 100% out-of-sample by construction
gates.note: any in-sample row in the score disqualifies the score, not the row

gates.name: Cost and execution realism
gates.threshold: stakes within limits; no promo credit counted as edge
gates.note: void/reprice handling must follow the filed house rule version

gates.name: Decay monitoring
gates.threshold: needs 250 bets with CLV
gates.note: not enough settled, priced bets to judge decay yet

gates.name: Compliance gate

gates.name: Deduplication of entries

ab_reconciliation.finding: Two captures of the same URL ~1 hour apart produced 24 rows and then 68 rows. They agree on all 22 players both of them rendered (0 disagreements), yet the second contains 46 players the first never showed, including 4 confirmed 'Out' designations. That is the specific failure this reconciliation exists to catch: a truncated render is not wrong, it is quietly short, and it looks like a quiet week. Ingestion therefore fetches until row counts stabilise, records (timestamp, row count, chunk coverage) per capture, reconciles at least two renders, and never overwrites.
